Last updated: 26 August 2026

DeHub is a decentralized, user-owned platform, but it is not a place without rules. These guidelines set out what is and is not allowed, how to report content, and what happens after a report is made. Policy is set by community governance; enforcement is carried out promptly by designated moderators.

What Is Not Allowed

The following content and behaviour are prohibited anywhere on DeHub, including posts, comments, streams, messages, profiles and usernames:

  • Illegal content of any kind, or content that facilitates illegal activity
  • Child sexual abuse material, or any sexualised depiction of minors. This is reported to the relevant authorities and results in immediate permanent removal
  • Incitement to violence, threats of violence, or glorification of violent extremism and terrorism
  • Harassment, bullying and targeted abuse, including coordinated pile-ons
  • Hate speech, including attacks on people based on race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, disability, disease, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation
  • Doxxing or publishing another person's private information without their consent
  • Spam, engagement manipulation, bot networks, and artificial inflation of views, votes or rewards
  • Impersonation of another person, creator, brand or project
  • Malware, phishing links, wallet drainers, and scam or fraudulent financial schemes

Adult Content

Explicit pornography is not permitted on DeHub and will be removed. Non-explicit nudity and mature themes are allowed but must be marked as mature using the content rating control when you post, so that other users and age-appropriate filters can handle it correctly. Repeatedly failing to mark mature content is itself a breach of these guidelines.

How to Report

Reporting takes a couple of taps and can be done from the content itself:

  • Any post, comment, stream or message can be reported using the report option on the item
  • You can block another account to stop all interaction with it
  • You can mute an account to remove it from your feeds without blocking it
  • For urgent or legal matters, email dev@dehub.io

What Happens Next

Reports are reviewed by designated moderators — community-elected administrators and top-ranking badge holders — who hold delegated authority to act without waiting for a governance vote.

  • Content that breaches these guidelines is removed
  • Accounts responsible for abusive behaviour are suspended or restricted
  • Repeat or severe breaches lead to permanent removal of the account
  • Illegal material is escalated to the appropriate authorities where required by law

Appeals

If you believe a moderation decision was wrong, it can be appealed through community governance. Governance sets the policy moderators enforce and can review or reverse individual decisions. Enforcement, however, is immediate — content stays down while an appeal is considered.

Contact

Questions about these guidelines, or reports that need urgent attention, can be sent to dev@dehub.io.
